answers.reason: The research associate holds no office that grants a seat in the senate.
Budget planning involves higher office holders due to university-wide planning, excluding the research associate.
Appointment committees deal with professorships and do not include research associates without specific regulations.
The research associate holds no office and the regulations do not provide a seat in the faculty council.
The research associate holds no office giving access to the study commission.
Examination boards do not include research associates by default or office.
Internal research funding rounds are handled without seats for research associates.
The module revision working group does not include research associates based on their position.
Laboratory equipment procurement is restricted and does not include the research associate.
Orientation week planning is not a body for which the research associate has a regulated seat.
